items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Just like Austin Cromer was another one, and Sonny Rollins loved him and my sister also.

ctx.x: And you know, Johnny Hartman, the voice he had, but he never really broke into the big time, do you have any understanding-
Just like Austin Cromer was another one, and Sonny Rollins loved him and my sister also.
